'''Cinta Larga''' is a [[Tupian language|Tupian]] [[dialect cluster]] of [[Brazil]], the largest language of the [[Monde languages|Monde branch]].

According to Moore (2005), [[Guariba Arára language|Arara do Rio Guariba]] (''Guariba River Arara''), spoken in the northern part of Aripuanã Indigenous Park, is closely related to the Cinta Larga dialect cluster, and also shares some features with [[Suruí language|Suruí]].<ref name="Moore-2005">Moore, Denny. 2005. [http://www.etnolinguistica.org/artigo:moore-2005 Classificação interna da família lingüística Mondé]. ''Estudos Lingüísticos'' 34: 515-520. ([http://www.etnolinguistica.org/local--files/artigo:moore-2005/moore_2005_monde.pdf PDF])</ref> 26 words were collected by Hargreaves in 2001.<ref>Hargreaves, Inês. 2007. ''[https://glottolog.org/resource/reference/id/97649 Lista de palavras transcritas por Inês Hargreaves, de dois grupos ao norte do Parque Aripuanã, RO]''. Manuscrito.</ref> This language remains unclassified due to the lack of data.
